description: Aboriginal Housing Services As Constructed - telecom_fitting (DOC-003) is a dataset listed in Western Australian Government data catalogue (catalogue.data.wa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department of Communities. This dataset contains location of fittings for telecommunication networks in remote Aboriginal settlements in Western Australia. These details have been derived from as-constructed surveys of remote Aboriginal settlements dating back to 1995. Coverage: Western Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Department of Communities. Its tags are Aboriginal Communities, Aboriginal Housing Services, As Constructed, Electrical Fittings, aboriginal housing services. It offers 7 resource(s) in api arcgis server map service, audio/basic, fgdb, geojson, geopackage. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Custom (Government Use). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-au-wa-portal.
